title: Kill switch falls back to local AWS credentials on a 403 and the fallback has no spec
description: From the review of #71. `cli/src/auritus/commands/killswitch.py` treats any `AuritusApiError`, including a 403 for a non-operator token, as an outage and retries through boto3 `UpdateJobQueue` with the caller's local AWS credentials. Decide whether the fallback should only run on connection errors or 5xx. The fallback path also has no Gherkin scenario (the specs mock `_batch_queue_state`); add one where the API returns 5xx and a moto Batch queue is toggled.
